main_measure.name: t of slope of excess next-day return on forecast, heavy-volume days, same-day cases pooled
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 with top-minus-bottom > 0 confirms; slope t <= -2 rejects; else inconclusive; needs >= 100 heavy-volume days over >= 50 distinct dates

supporting_check.name: top-third minus bottom-third forecast mean excess next-day return (Welch t 2.277)

decided_by: Confirm: the slope t is 2 or more and the top-minus-bottom difference is above 0.
reading: Heavy-volume days are the bars with regime 'trending' and a next-day close in the same window, including those with forecast 0; the slope's t pools same-day cases with standard errors clustered by date (CR1); thirds are the lowest and highest n//3 cases by forecast with ties ordered by time then coin; the coin mean is its mean 1-day return over all its windows.
